```{r init, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare"}
PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE <- get0("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", inherits = TRUE,
  ifnotfound = Sys.getenv("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", unset = "describe"))
stopifnot(PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE %in% c("describe", "differential", "enrichment"))
OUTPUT_FIG_DIR <- SINGLE_FIG
OUTPUT_TAB_DIR <- SINGLE_TAB
prepare_module_outputs(
  OUTPUT_FIG_DIR,
  OUTPUT_TAB_DIR,
  c(
    "01_sample_qc",
    "02_sector_radar",
    "03_sports_sncRNA_distribution",
    "04_length_distribution",
    "05_relative_ratios",
    "06_tsrna_origin",
    "07_rsrna_sector_radar",
    "02_sports_sncRNA_distribution",
    "03_length_distribution",
    "06_relative_ratios"
  )
)
activate_serum_context(environment())
PANDORA_CAN_PCA <- nrow(sample_info) >= 3L
pandora_group_n <- table(as.character(sample_info$Group))
PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE <- length(pandora_group_n) >= 2L && all(pandora_group_n >= 2L)
write_csv_safe(tibble(
  AnalysisStage = PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE,
  AnalysisScope = get0("analysis_scope", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = "all"),
  LibraryN = nrow(sample_info), GroupN = length(pandora_group_n),
  PCAApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_PCA, GroupComparisonApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE
), "analysis_stage_status.csv")
```

```{r single-plot-helpers, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare", eval=TRUE}
plot_sample_qc <- function(sample_id, tbl) {
  df <- tbl %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id) %>%
    select(Sample, Group, CleanReads, MatchGenome, GenomeRate, DominantCategory, DominantPercent) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(CleanReads, MatchGenome), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Reads")
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(plot_note(sample_id, "No QC data."))
  meta_row <- df %>% slice(1)
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Metric, y = Reads, fill = Metric)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.62) +
    geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(round(Reads, 0))), vjust = -0.35, size = 3.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = serum_qc_palette) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Reads",
      title = paste0(sample_id, " QC"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Group ", meta_row$Group[[1]],
        " | Genome: ", sprintf("%.2f%%", meta_row$GenomeRate[[1]]),
        " | Dominant: ", meta_row$DominantCategory[[1]],
        " (", sprintf("%.2f%%", meta_row$DominantPercent[[1]]), ")"
      )
    ) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

plot_sports_stacked_length <- function(sample_id, df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0 || sum(df$RPM, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(plot_note(sample_id, "No sncRNA length data."))
  plot_df <- df %>% group_by(Category) %>% filter(sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>% ungroup()
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPM, fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sports_length_palette, drop = TRUE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(plot_df$Length), max(plot_df$Length), by = 5), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))) +
    labs(x = "Length", y = "RPM", title = paste(sample_id, "sncRNA length distribution")) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")
}

plot_sports_category_length <- function(sample_id, category_name, df) {
  category_df <- df %>% filter(as.character(Category) == category_name)
  if (nrow(category_df) == 0 || sum(category_df$RPM, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(plot_note(paste(sample_id, category_name), "No length data."))
  }
  ggplot(category_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPM)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.84, fill = sports_length_palette[[category_name]], color = "white", linewidth = 0.12) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(category_df$Length), max(category_df$Length), by = 5), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.08))) +
    labs(x = "Length", y = "RPM", title = paste(sample_id, category_name, "length distribution")) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}

plot_relative_ratios_sample <- function(sample_id, df, view = REPORT_VIEW) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id, Reads > 0) %>%
    mutate(MainCategory = factor(as.character(MainCategory), levels = category_levels))
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(plot_note(paste(sample_id, view), "No ratio data."))
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = MainCategory, y = Percent, fill = MainCategory)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Percent >= 0.25, sprintf("%.1f", Percent), "")), vjust = -0.25, size = 3.0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = category_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Percent of clean reads",
      title = paste0(sample_id, " sncRNA relative ratios", view_title_suffix(view))
    ) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
}

plot_sample_length_all <- function(sample_id, df, view = REPORT_VIEW) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id, RPM > 0) %>%
    filter_direction_view(view) %>%
    mutate(MainCategory = factor(as.character(MainCategory), levels = length_focus_categories))
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(plot_note(paste(sample_id, view), "No length data."))
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPM, color = MainCategory)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.76) +
    geom_point(size = 0.85) +
    sncrna_length_axis() +
    scale_color_manual(values = category_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.08))) +
    labs(
      x = "Length",
      y = "RPM",
      title = paste0(sample_id, " length architecture", view_title_suffix(view))
    ) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")
}

plot_sample_length_category <- function(sample_id, category_name, df, view = REPORT_VIEW) {
  category_df <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id, as.character(MainCategory) == category_name, RPM > 0) %>%
    filter_direction_view(view)
  if (nrow(category_df) == 0) return(plot_note(paste(sample_id, category_name, view), "No length data."))
  ggplot(category_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPM)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.86, color = category_palette[[category_name]]) +
    geom_point(size = 0.85, color = category_palette[[category_name]]) +
    sncrna_length_axis() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.08))) +
    labs(
      x = "Length",
      y = "RPM",
      title = paste0(sample_id, " ", category_name, " length", view_title_suffix(view))
    ) +
    serum_theme_bw()
}

build_sample_sports_collage <- function(sample_id, df) {
  category_order <- df %>%
    group_by(Category) %>%
    summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(TotalRPM > 0, !is.na(Category)) %>%
    arrange(desc(TotalRPM), match(as.character(Category), sports_length_categories)) %>%
    pull(Category) %>%
    as.character()
  build_plot_collage(
    map(category_order, ~plot_sports_category_length(sample_id, .x, df)),
    title_text = paste0(sample_id, " sncRNA length collage"),
    cols = 4
  )
}

build_sample_length_collage <- function(sample_id, df) {
  category_order <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id) %>%
    group_by(MainCategory) %>%
    summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(TotalRPM > 0, !is.na(MainCategory)) %>%
    arrange(desc(TotalRPM), match(as.character(MainCategory), length_focus_categories)) %>%
    pull(MainCategory) %>%
    as.character()
  build_plot_collage(
    map(category_order, ~plot_sample_length_category(sample_id, .x, df, view = REPORT_VIEW)),
    title_text = paste0(sample_id, " fitted length collage", view_title_suffix(REPORT_VIEW)),
    cols = 4
  )
}

plot_rsrna_sector_radar_sample <- function(sample_id, rsrna_plot_df, radar_max, radar_breaks, view = REPORT_VIEW) {
  rsrna_radar_angle_offset <- -pi / length(rsrna_radar_levels)
  plot_df <- rsrna_plot_df %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id) %>%
    transmute(PieCategory = as.character(RsRNAClass), Reads, Percent) %>%
    build_sector_radar_df(
      radar_max = radar_max,
      sector_levels = rsrna_radar_levels,
      sector_labels = rsrna_radar_labels,
      sector_palette = rsrna_radar_palette,
      bottom_anchor_category = "18S-rRNA",
      angle_offset = rsrna_radar_angle_offset
    )

  plot_sector_radar_core(
    plot_df = plot_df,
    title_text = paste0("rsRNA Proportion of ", sample_id, view_title_suffix(view)),
    radar_max = radar_max,
    radar_breaks = radar_breaks,
    sector_levels = rsrna_radar_levels,
    sector_palette = rsrna_radar_palette,
    axis_label = "Relative Abundance within total rsRNA (%)"
  )
}
```

```{r single-tsrna-data, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare", eval=TRUE}
ts_main_counts <- summary_all %>%
  filter(SubClass == "-", str_detect(Class, "^(GtRNAdb|mitotRNAdb)")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Class) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Class, values_from = Reads, values_fill = 0)

ts_main_wide <- sample_info %>%
  transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group)) %>%
  left_join(ts_main_counts, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(.x, 0)))

ts_origin_breakdown <- ts_main_wide %>%
  mutate(
    GenomicPreTotal = get_col(., "GtRNAdb-pre-tRNA_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "GtRNAdb-pre-tRNA_Unmatch_Genome"),
    GenomicMatureTotal = get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_Unmatch_Genome"),
    GenomicFiveEnd = get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_5_end_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_5_end_Unmatch_Genome"),
    GenomicThreeEnd = get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_3_end_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_3_end_Unmatch_Genome"),
    GenomicCCAEnd = get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_CCA_end_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_CCA_end_Unmatch_Genome"),
    GenomicInternal = pmax(GenomicMatureTotal - GenomicFiveEnd - GenomicThreeEnd - GenomicCCAEnd, 0),
    MitoMatureTotal = get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_Unmatch_Genome"),
    MitoFiveEnd = get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_5_end_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_5_end_Unmatch_Genome"),
    MitoThreeEnd = get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_3_end_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_3_end_Unmatch_Genome"),
    MitoCCAEnd = get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_CCA_end_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_CCA_end_Unmatch_Genome"),
    MitoInternal = pmax(MitoMatureTotal - MitoFiveEnd - MitoThreeEnd - MitoCCAEnd, 0),
    Genomic = GenomicPreTotal + GenomicMatureTotal,
    Mitochondrial = MitoMatureTotal
  )

ts_origin_sample <- ts_origin_breakdown %>%
  select(Sample, Group, Genomic, Mitochondrial) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Genomic, Mitochondrial), names_to = "Origin", values_to = "Reads") %>%
  mutate(Origin = recode(Origin, Genomic = "Genomic tRNA", Mitochondrial = "Mitochondrial tRNA")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

ts_genomic_cleavage_sample <- ts_origin_breakdown %>%
  select(Sample, Group, GenomicFiveEnd, GenomicThreeEnd, GenomicCCAEnd, GenomicInternal) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(GenomicFiveEnd, GenomicThreeEnd, GenomicCCAEnd, GenomicInternal), names_to = "Cleavage", values_to = "Reads") %>%
  mutate(
    Cleavage = recode(
      Cleavage,
      GenomicFiveEnd = "Genomic tRNA 5'end",
      GenomicThreeEnd = "Genomic tRNA 3'end",
      GenomicCCAEnd = "Genomic tRNA CCA-end",
      GenomicInternal = "Genomic tRNA internal"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

ts_mito_cleavage_sample <- ts_origin_breakdown %>%
  select(Sample, Group, MitoFiveEnd, MitoThreeEnd, MitoCCAEnd, MitoInternal) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(MitoFiveEnd, MitoThreeEnd, MitoCCAEnd, MitoInternal), names_to = "Cleavage", values_to = "Reads") %>%
  mutate(
    Cleavage = recode(
      Cleavage,
      MitoFiveEnd = "Mitochondrial tRNA 5'end",
      MitoThreeEnd = "Mitochondrial tRNA 3'end",
      MitoCCAEnd = "Mitochondrial tRNA CCA-end",
      MitoInternal = "Mitochondrial tRNA internal"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r generate-radar, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
pie_by_view <- setNames(lapply(VIEW_LEVELS, function(view_name) compute_pie_tables(filter_direction_view(summary_top, view_name))), VIEW_LEVELS)
radar_max <- max(c(30, unlist(lapply(pie_by_view, function(df) if (nrow(df) == 0) 0 else max(df$Percent, na.rm = TRUE)))), na.rm = TRUE)
radar_max <- max(ceiling(radar_max / 5) * 5, 30)
radar_breaks <- unique(round(seq(0, radar_max, length.out = 5), 2))

for (sample_id in as.character(sample_info$Sample)) {
  for (view_name in VIEW_LEVELS) {
    save_plot_nested(
      plot_sector_radar_sample(sample_id, pie_by_view[[view_name]], radar_max, radar_breaks, view = view_name),
      "02_sector_radar",
      paste0("sector_radar_", sample_id, ".pdf"),
      sample = sample_id,
      width = 8,
      height = 8,
      view = view_name
    )
  }
}
```

```{r generate-sports-length, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
sports_redraw <- map(as.character(sample_info$Sample), compute_sports_snc_for_sample, length_df = length_all, sample_info_tbl = sample_info)

  sample_df <- sports_length_by_sample %>% filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id)
  collage_count <- sample_df %>%
    group_by(Category) %>%
    summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%

  save_plot_nested(
    plot_sports_stacked_length(sample_id, sample_df),
    "03_sports_sncRNA_distribution",
    paste0("sports_length_stacked_all_", sample_id, ".pdf"),
    sample = sample_id,
    width = 11,
    height = 6,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
  save_plot_nested(
    build_sample_sports_collage(sample_id, sample_df),
    "03_sports_sncRNA_distribution",
    paste0("sports_length_all_categories_", sample_id, ".pdf"),
    sample = sample_id,
    width = collage_dims$width,
    height = collage_dims$height,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}
```

```{r processing-report-index, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
processing_report_index <- sample_info %>%
  transmute(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Replicate = as.character(Replicate),
    ProcessingReport = map_chr(Sample, function(sample_id) {
      report_dir <- file.path(SPORTS_RESULT_DIR, sample_id, "processing_report")
      report_files <- list.files(report_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
      if (length(report_files) == 0) NA_character_ else report_files[[1]]
    })
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ProcessingReportExists = !is.na(ProcessingReport) & file.exists(ProcessingReport),
    ProcessingReportSizeBytes = map_dbl(
      ProcessingReport,
      ~if (!is.na(.x) && file.exists(.x)) file.info(.x)$size else NA_real_
    )
  )
```
